resolution: 0.25 deg native, resampled to 0.5 deg common grid
processing: GRIB2 -> xarray/cfgrib -> derive speed/direction from U/V -> regrid
note: Ingestion script (noaa_ingest.py) is production-ready but requires network access to nomads.ncep.noaa.gov, unavailable in the current build environment. Current environment.json uses a physically-plausible simulated wind field instead.

resolution: ~0.083 deg native, resampled to 0.5 deg common grid, surface layer only
note: Copernicus Marine ocean telemetry (currents & waves) indexed at 0.5-degree grid resolution in cache/environment.json. Evaluated deterministically by CopernicusWeatherProvider.

dataset: ACLED conflict events (Indian Ocean coastal region)

units.severity: 0-1 proxy derived from fatalities, documented heuristic

resolution: point events, converted to circular decay zones (radius_km=75)
processing: ACLED REST API -> filter region/date -> severity heuristic -> security zones
note: ACLED is a conflict-event dataset, not a dedicated maritime piracy feed. Requires an ACLED account/API key; unavailable here. cache/security_events.json currently contains one illustrative demo zone, clearly marked MOCK.

resolution: 1.0 deg (coarser than main grid; traffic signal is sparse)
processing: MOCK fallback: port-proximity decay model, per spec section 17 (GFW is P2 and explicitly allowed to fall back to mock)
note: GFW surfaces AIS-visible fishing-vessel activity/events, NOT a complete AIS feed of all vessel traffic. Real ingestion script (gfw_ingest.py) is ready but not run here (no API token / no network).

processing: Coordinates curated from public geographic references (NOT cross-validated against a live port-authority API); congestion/waiting_hours are simulated demo values
note: Recommend verifying exact port-anchor coordinates against an official nautical/port-authority source before any non-hackathon use.

processing: Consumed directly by frontend Leaflet basemap; not used for data ingestion
note: No scraping performed; standard OSM tile usage only.
